interface.name: list_branches
interface.title: List Store Branches
interface.description: Returns a paginated list of the store's branches and warehouses, each with its name, city, type, active status and whether it is the store's default branch.
whenToUse: The merchant wants an overview of their physical locations, e.g. 'what branches do I have?' or 'list my warehouses'.
The merchant asks which branch is the default one used for operations -- filter with the isDefault argument.
The merchant asks whether a branch in a particular place still exists, e.g. 'do I have a Jeddah branch?' -- filter with the keyword argument.
An agent needs a branch id before reading one specific branch, or before reporting stock or sales per location.
whenNotToUse: The merchant named ONE specific branch and wants its full record -- working hours, contacts, full address -- use get_branch with the branch id instead.
The merchant wants to open a branch, rename one, or change its address or working hours -- use create_branch or update_branch; this tool only reads.
The merchant wants the stock held at a location rather than the locations themselves -- use list_product_quantities filtered by branch instead.

page.description: Pagination page number. The response returns one page of branches; increment to fetch the rest.

keyword.description: Filter branches to those matching this keyword, typically part of the branch name.

isDefault.description: Filter to the store's default branch (true) or to the non-default ones (false). Omit to list every branch.

id.description: The branch id, used by sibling branch tools and by per-location reporting.

name.description: The branch's display name, in the store's own language.

type.description: What the location is: 'branch' (a place customers can reach) or 'warehouse'.

status.description: Whether the branch is 'active' or 'inactive' for the store's operations.

is_default.description: True for the branch the store falls back to for its operations.

city.description: The city the branch sits in.

id.description: The city id, as Salla identifies it.

name.description: The city name in the store's language.

components._comment: The city in the store's own language, so it reads beside the branch name rather than against it.

http.summary: List Branches -- list all branches related to your store, filterable by a keyword or by whether the branch is the store's default one.

query.name: keyword
query.description: A keyword to search the store's branches by.

query.name: is_default
query.description: Whether or not this branch is the default one for all operations.

statuses.meaning: The store's access token is missing, expired, or does not carry the branches.read scope, so the store's branches cannot be read until the app's authorization is fixed.

caching._comment: A store's branches are near-static configuration -- opening or closing one is a deliberate act a merchant performs rarely -- so a longer TTL is safe and spares the upstream a call per question about locations.
